item.title: 看到华为三星折叠机受关注后，库克推动苹果加速研发折叠屏 iPhone
item.guid: 看到华为三星折叠机受关注后，库克推动苹果加速研发折叠屏-iPhone
item.description:
According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple's journey to develop a foldable iPhone has spanned nearly a decade. The device is expected to cost over $2000, marking Apple's biggest design change in nearly 20 years. 据彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果研发折叠屏 iPhone 的历程已历时近十年，该设备售价预计将超过 2000 美元，标志着苹果近 20 年来最大的设计变革。

The report reveals that Apple's interest in foldable devices can be traced back to around 2020. At that time, after concluding an Asian trip, Apple CEO Tim Cook showed an unusually positive attitude towards the emerging category of foldable phones. 报道披露，苹果对折叠设备的关注可追溯至 2020 年前后。彼时苹果 CEO Tim Cook 在结束一次亚洲之行后，对折叠屏手机这一新兴品类表现出了异乎寻常的积极态度。

During his visits to Asian regions including China, Tim Cook observed an increasing number of consumers using foldable devices from manufacturers like Samsung Electronics and Huawei. This observation convinced him that Apple must launch its own foldable product, and he immediately pushed the company to accelerate its R&D efforts in this emerging market. 在走访中国等亚洲地区的行程中，Tim Cook 观察到越来越多消费者开始使用来自三星电子、华为等手机厂商的折叠屏设备。这次见闻让他确信苹果必须推出自家的折叠产品，并随即推动公司加速在这一新兴市场的研发步伐。

item.title: OpenAI 发布 Navier–Stokes 千禧年难题候选解，等待数学界检验
item.guid: OpenAI-发布-Navier–Stokes-千禧年难题候选解，等待数学界检验
item.description:
On September 8, OpenAI announced a candidate solution to the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem, simultaneously releasing a mathematical paper and a Lean formal proof. The company states that this proof provides a construction for the formation of singularities in smooth three-dimensional incompressible fluids within a finite time, corresponding to cases C and D in the Clay Mathematics Institute's problem statement. OpenAI 9 月 8 日公布一份 Navier–Stokes 存在性与光滑性问题的候选解，同时发布了数学论文和 Lean 形式化证明。公司称，这份证明给出了光滑三维不可压缩流体在有限时间内形成奇点的构造，对应克莱数学研究所问题表述中的 C 和 D 类情形。

OpenAI states that the proof was completed by an internal model with capabilities superior to GPT-6 Astra, with the system at one point coordinating approximately 10,000 concurrent agents. It took about 88 hours from initiation to obtaining the candidate solution, followed by GPT-6 Astra spending 17 hours to complete the Lean formalization and verification; the Navier–Stokes project generated approximately 2.7 million agent messages and 130 billion output tokens. OpenAI 称，证明由一个能力高于 GPT-6 Astra 的内部模型完成，系统一度协调约 1 万个并发 Agent。从启动到得到候选解用时约 88 小时，随后由 GPT-6 Astra 花费 17 小时完成 Lean 形式化和验证；Navier–Stokes 项目共产生约 270 万条代理消息和 1300 亿个输出 token。

This work also brought up a contemporary controversy regarding Euler equations research. Tristan Buckmaster, a mathematics professor at New York University, questioned whether OpenAI used project data from him and Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge in Codex. OpenAI stated that the solution process did not access specific user data but could not completely rule out that de-identified usage data had participated in model improvements; the problems addressed by the proofs publicly released by both parties are also not the same. 这项工作也牵出了同期的 Euler 方程研究争议。纽约大学数学教授 Tristan Buckmaster 质疑 OpenAI 是否利用了他与 Anthropic 研究人员 Levent Alpöge 在 Codex 中的项目数据。OpenAI 称求解过程没有访问具体用户数据，但不能完全排除去标识化使用数据曾参与模型改进；双方公开的证明所针对的问题也并不相同。

This candidate solution has not yet undergone independent verification by the global mathematical community. According to Clay Mathematics Institute rules, a solution must first be published in a qualified publication, undergo at least two years of rigorous review, and gain widespread acceptance before being considered for an award. OpenAI stated it has no intention of applying for an award for this result. 这份候选解尚未经过全球数学界的独立检验。按克莱数学研究所规则，一项解答需先在合格出版物发表，至少经过两年严格审查并获得广泛认可，才会进入奖项考虑程序。OpenAI 称无意为该结果申请奖项。

🔗 Related reading: Just now, OpenAI announced it has tackled a Millennium Prize Problem; Chen Lijie, a legend from Tsinghua's Yao Class: An incredible era 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，OpenAI 宣布攻克千禧年难题，清华姚班传奇陈立杰：不可思议的时代

item.title: DeepSeek Flash 系列 9 月 10 日起降价，V4.1 Flash 同步开启内测
item.guid: DeepSeek-Flash-系列-9-月-10-日起降价，V4.1-Flash-同步开启内测
item.description:
DeepSeek will significantly adjust the pricing of its flash series models starting at 12:00 on September 10th. Off-peak input prices will drop from 1.5 yuan to 1 yuan per million tokens, off-peak output prices from 4.5 yuan to 4 yuan, and off-peak cache prices from 0.05 yuan to 0.02 yuan; peak-time prices will be double the off-peak rates. DeepSeek 将于 9 月 10 日 12:00 起大幅调整 flash 系列模型定价，闲时输入价格从每百万 token 1.5 元降至 1 元，闲时输出价格从 4.5 元降至 4 元，闲时缓存价格从 0.05 元降至 0.02 元；高峰时段价格为闲时价格的 2 倍。

Meanwhile, the intermediate version of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now open for internal testing. API users participating in the internal test do not need to change the base_url; they can simply switch the model name to "deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910" to call it. Current billing is the same as DeepSeek V4 Flash, and a single account supports a maximum of 20 concurrent requests. 与此同时，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 中间版本已开放内测。参与内测的 API 用户无需更改 base_url，将模型名切换为「deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910」即可调用，当前计费与 DeepSeek V4 Flash 相同，单账号最多支持 20 并发请求。

The expiration date in this model ID is September 10th, making it a short-term internal test version that has not yet replaced the official V4 Flash model in the official API documentation. The new version adopts a different model architecture, natively supports multimodal capabilities, and this round of testing focuses on capabilities, generation speed, and inference cost. 该模型 ID 中的失效日期为 9 月 10 日，属短期内测版本，尚未替换官网 API 文档中的正式 V4 Flash 型号，新版本采用不同的模型架构，原生支持多模态，本轮测试重点为能力、生成速度和推理成本。

🔗 Related reading: Just now, DeepSeek's new model suddenly went online, a Flash model with Pro ambitions 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，DeepSeek 新模型突然上线，Flash 的模型，Pro 的野心

item.title: 两部门要求车企定期报告供应商账期，重点企业每年接受评估
item.guid: 两部门要求车企定期报告供应商账期，重点企业每年接受评估
item.description:
On September 7, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the State Administration for Market Regulation issued a notice to further regulate payments made by automotive companies to suppliers for goods, engineering, and services. Car manufacturers are required to establish a supplier payment management system and submit semi-annual and annual implementation reports by the end of July and the end of January of the following year, respectively. 工业和信息化部、市场监管总局 9 月 7 日发布通知，进一步规范汽车企业向供应商支付采购货物、工程和服务等款项。车企需建立供应商账款支付管理制度，并在每年 7 月底和次年 1 月底前分别提交半年度、年度执行情况报告。

The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology will commission a third-party agency to conduct an annual survey and evaluation, covering all key automotive companies on the list. The evaluation will review company documents and data, verify on-site conditions, and interview employees, focusing on information such as payment terms, payment methods and proportions, and the scale of accounts payable. The results will be publicly released. 工信部将委托第三方机构每年开展一次调研评估，对名单内重点车企实现全覆盖。评估会查阅企业文件和数据、核验现场并访谈员工，关注账期、支付方式及占比、应付账款规模等信息，结果将公开发布。

For automotive companies with large accounts payable, those intentionally extending payment terms, or those frequently complained about by small and medium-sized enterprises, the competent authorities will conduct interviews and urge rectification; if violations are involved, they will be dealt with according to law. Previously, the industry launched a "60-day payment term commitment" in 2025, and this notice incorporates corporate reporting, third-party evaluation, complaint verification, and law enforcement coordination into the normalized management process. 对于应付账款规模较大、故意拉长账期或被中小企业投诉较多的车企，主管部门将约谈并督促整改；涉及违法违规的，将依法处理。此前行业在 2025 年发起「60 天账期承诺」，此次通知把企业报告、第三方评估、投诉核查和执法衔接写入常态化管理流程。

item.title: 小米中折叠「卖爆了」，首销较上代大折叠增长 310%
item.guid: 小米中折叠「卖爆了」，首销较上代大折叠增长-310%
item.description: Xu Fei, Vice President and CMO of Xiaomi Group, stated on September 8 that the first sales of Xiaomi 18 Fold increased by 310% compared to its predecessor, the large foldable. This mid-fold phone was launched the previous night with a starting price of 10,999 yuan, making it Xiaomi's highest-positioned phone product currently. 小米集团副总裁、CMO 许斐 9 月 8 日表示，小米 18 Fold 首销较上代大折叠增长 310%。这款中折叠手机前一晚发布，起售价为 10999 元，是小米目前定位最高的手机产品。

item.title: 曝微信 PC 版接入 AI 助手「小微」，可操作聊天与小程序
item.guid: 曝微信-PC-版接入-AI-助手「小微」，可操作聊天与小程序
item.description:
WeChat has started testing its AI assistant 'Xiaowei' on the PC version. It can view Moments, send messages, initiate voice and video calls, and answer file content in chats; video files and scheduled messages are not yet supported. 微信开始在 PC 版测试 AI 助手「小微」。它能查看朋友圈、发送消息、发起语音和视频通话，也能在聊天中回答文件内容；视频文件和定时消息暂不支持。

'Xiaowei' can also invoke mini-programs to complete services like ordering food, and payment-related actions will require user confirmation. The 'Yuanbao Summary' entry in WeChat's built-in browser has also been replaced with 'Ask AI', allowing users to continue asking questions about the current webpage. 「小微」还能调用小程序完成订餐等服务，涉及支付时会交由用户确认。微信内置浏览器的「元宝总结」入口也被替换为「问 AI」，可继续围绕当前网页提问。

Developer-facing capabilities include developing and debugging mini-programs on PC, and generating trial versions. Personalized recommendations are off by default and can be enabled by users in settings; currently, there is no option to disable the 'Xiaowei' entry. 面向开发者的能力包括在 PC 端开发和调试小程序、生成体验版。个性化推荐默认关闭，用户可在设置中单独开启；目前没有提供关闭「小微」入口的选项。

item.title: 蔚来与云南交投新一批高速换电站投运，覆盖 5 条高速双向服务区
item.guid: 蔚来与云南交投新一批高速换电站投运，覆盖-5-条高速双向服务区
item.description:
NIO Energy and Yunnan Communications Investment Group announced on September 8th that a new batch of jointly built highway battery swap stations has been fully put into operation. The stations are located at Disuoping on G5621 Kunchuda Expressway, Huize on G85 Yinkun Expressway, Shizong on G78 Shankun Expressway, Yuanmou on G5 Jingkun Expressway, and Tongguan Service Area on G8511 Kunmo Expressway, with all 5 service areas completing bidirectional deployment. 蔚来能源与云南交投 9 月 8 日宣布，双方新一批共建高速换电站已全面投入运营。站点分别落在 G5621 昆楚大高速地索坪、G85 银昆高速会泽、G78 汕昆高速师宗、G5 京昆高速元谋和 G8511 昆磨高速通关服务区，5 处服务区均完成双向布点。

This marks a new round of operations following the first batch of cooperation between the two parties in 2024. The new stations connect major routes in central, eastern, western, and southern Yunnan, complementing high-speed battery swap nodes for inter-regional and long-distance travel within the province. The two parties will also further promote high-speed 'solar-storage-charging-swapping' integrated energy stations and zero-carbon service areas. 这是双方继 2024 年首批合作后的新一轮投运。新站点连接滇中、滇东、滇西和滇南主要通道，补齐省内跨区域、长距离行程中的高速换电节点。双方后续还将推进高速「光储充换」综合能源站和零碳服务区。

As of September 8th, NIO stated that it has built 9,328 charging and battery swap stations, including 4,075 battery swap stations and 5,253 charging stations, equipped with 30,284 charging piles; it has cumulatively completed over 120 million battery swap services, with a total of over 200 million charging and battery swap services. 截至 9 月 8 日，蔚来称其已建成 9328 座充换电站，其中换电站 4075 座、充电站 5253 座，配备 30284 根充电桩；累计完成超 1.2 亿次换电服务，充换电服务合计超 2 亿次。

item.title: DeepSeek 新开约 150 个工程岗位，聚焦后端与 Agent 弹性计算
item.guid: DeepSeek-新开约-150-个工程岗位，聚焦后端与-Agent-弹性计算
item.description:
Cui Tianyi, head of the DeepSeek Harness team, publicly announced on September 7th that they are recruiting approximately 150 people. These positions are primarily for engineers with 2 to 10 years of experience, but fresh graduates and entry-level professionals are also welcome; the main work location is Beijing, with some positions available in Hangzhou. DeepSeek Harness 团队负责人崔添翼 9 月 7 日公开招聘约 150 人。这批名额主要面向有 2 至 10 年经验的工程师，也接受应届生和初入行从业者；工作地点以北京为主，部分岗位可选杭州。

Recruitment is focused on two types of positions: server-side development and Agent elastic computing R&D. The former covers large model research platforms, Agent framework components, R&D efficiency infrastructure, DeepSeek API, online services, and data engineering; the latter includes platform development and maintenance, and underlying system optimization. There are no separate AI research positions in this round. 招聘集中在服务端开发和 Agent 弹性计算研发两类岗位。前者覆盖大模型研究平台、Agent 框架组件、研发效率基建、DeepSeek API、线上服务和数据工程；后者包括平台开发维护与底层系统调优。本轮没有单列 AI 研究岗位。

Cui Tianyi explained that data, machines and containers, training and evaluation tasks, Agent environments, and user requests are all growing, requiring the existing backend system to be upgraded, maintained, or even rewritten. In June, DeepSeek had announced plans to at least double the size of its various departments; this recruitment round focuses on a more concentrated range of positions. 崔添翼解释称，数据、机器与容器、训练和评测任务、Agent 环境以及用户请求都在增长，原有后端系统需要升级、维护甚至重写。此前 6 月，DeepSeek 曾宣布计划将各部门规模至少扩大一倍；此次招聘的岗位范围更集中。

item.title: 高通与亚马逊达成多代定制芯片合作，覆盖 AI 推理与 1.6T 光互联
item.guid: 高通与亚马逊达成多代定制芯片合作，覆盖-AI-推理与-1.6T-光互联
item.description:
Qualcomm announced on September 8th a multi-generational product collaboration with Amazon. The two parties will develop custom chips for AWS's large-scale AI data centers and jointly advance AI inference infrastructure. The cooperation will also cover optical interconnects up to 1.6T and subsequent solutions. 高通 9 月 8 日宣布与亚马逊达成多代产品合作，双方将为 AWS 的大规模 AI 数据中心开发定制芯片，并共同推进 AI 推理基础设施。合作还将覆盖最高 1.6T 的光互联及后续方案。

Qualcomm will provide SerDes, optical DSP, low-power computing, and system integration capabilities to enhance high-bandwidth interconnects within data centers. Amazon will provide cloud-based AI infrastructure, and both parties aim to create a scalable solution across computing, storage, network bandwidth, and energy efficiency. 高通将提供 SerDes、光学 DSP、低功耗计算和系统集成能力，用于提升数据中心内部高带宽互联。亚马逊则提供云端 AI 基础设施，双方希望在计算、存储、网络带宽和能效之间形成一套可扩展方案。

Qualcomm also plans to expand its use of AWS AI infrastructure and Amazon Bedrock for electronic design automation workloads to shorten chip design cycles. 高通还计划扩大对 AWS AI 基础设施和 Amazon Bedrock 的使用，把它们用于电子设计自动化工作负载，以缩短芯片设计周期。

item.title: 《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》12 月 8 日停运，日文原版不受影响
item.guid: 《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》12-月-8-日停运，日文原版不受影响
item.description:
Travel Frog: China Tour announced on September 8th that due to the expiration of its IP licensing cooperation, the game will officially cease operations at 18:00 on December 8th. As of 14:00 on the same day, all platform download portals, top-ups, and new user registrations have been closed. 《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》9 月 8 日宣布，因 IP 授权合作到期，游戏将于 12 月 8 日 18:00 正式停止运营。当日 14:00 起，全平台下载入口、充值和新用户注册已经关闭。

After the shutdown, all account data and character information will be cleared. Paid clover obtained through top-ups within the last 3 months and not consumed can be applied for a refund between September 8th and December 8th. Official server users can submit through in-game customer service, while channel server and iOS users need to contact their respective channels. 停运后，所有账号数据和角色资料将被清空。近 3 个月内充值获得且未消耗的付费三叶草可在 9 月 8 日至 12 月 8 日期间申请退款，官服用户可通过游戏内客服提交，渠道服和 iOS 用户需联系对应渠道。

The Chinese version was launched by Lingxi Interactive Entertainment in 2018 after obtaining authorization from Hit-Point. This shutdown only affects Travel Frog: China Tour; the original Japanese version, Tabikaeru, operated by Hit-Point, remains in normal operation. 中国版由灵犀互娱在 2018 年获得 Hit-Point 授权后推出。此次停运只涉及《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》，Hit-Point 运营的日文原版《旅かえる》仍在正常运营。

item.title: Meta 发布个人 AI Agent Muse，可持续代办邮件、旅行和购物
item.guid: Meta-发布个人-AI-Agent-Muse，可持续代办邮件、旅行和购物
item.description:
Meta released its personal AI Agent Muse on September 8th. Users can converse with it in a standalone app or WhatsApp, allowing it to break down goals, formulate plans, and continue executing tasks even after the user closes the app. Meta 9 月 8 日发布个人 AI Agent Muse。用户可在独立应用或 WhatsApp 中与它对话，让其拆解目标、制定计划，并在用户关闭应用后继续执行任务。

Muse is powered by the Muse Spark model and can open browsers, fill out forms, send emails, book travel, and complete shopping. It can also connect to Meta products like Instagram and third-party apps, for example, organizing user-saved recipe Reels into a shopping list, or generating a menu based on guest dietary preferences before a dinner party. Muse 由 Muse Spark 模型驱动，可打开浏览器、填写表单、发送邮件、预订旅行和完成购物。它还能连接 Instagram 等 Meta 产品与第三方应用，例如将用户保存的食谱 Reels 整理成采购清单，或在宴请前根据宾客饮食偏好生成菜单。

To isolate Agent and user data, Meta configures a dedicated cloud-based Muse Secure VM for each Muse and has a Sentinel, isolated from the main Agent system, review external requests. Sensitive actions like sending emails or making payments require user confirmation. Account passwords and payment information are stored in a separate secure area, inaccessible to Muse itself. Users can choose associated apps and permissions, and can also opt out of using interactions for model training. 为隔离 Agent 与用户数据，Meta 为每个 Muse 配置专用云端 Muse Secure VM，并让一个与主 Agent 系统隔离的 Sentinel 审查对外请求。发送邮件、付款等敏感动作需用户确认，账号密码和支付信息存入独立安全区，Muse 本身无法查看。用户可选择关联的应用和权限，也可退出将互动用于模型训练。

Muse has been progressively rolled out to iOS, Android, and web users in the United States, and will subsequently be available on Meta AI glasses. Basic features are primarily free, and Meta is also preparing subscription plans for high-intensity users. Muse 已在美国面向 iOS、Android 和网页用户陆续开放，后续将登陆 Meta AI 眼镜。基础功能主要免费，Meta 同时准备面向高强度使用者的订阅方案。

item.title: Robinhood 首次进入 IPO 承销团，参与 Oura 上市
item.guid: Robinhood-首次进入-IPO-承销团，参与-Oura-上市
item.description:
According to the prospectus filed by smart ring company Oura with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Robinhood has joined its IPO underwriting syndicate, participating in the offering alongside institutions such as Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan Chase, Allen & Company, and Jefferies. The Wall Street Journal stated that this is the first time Robinhood has officially served as an IPO underwriter. 智能戒指公司 Oura 向美国证券交易委员会提交的招股书显示，Robinhood 已进入其 IPO 承销商名单，与高盛、摩根士丹利、摩根大通、Allen & Company 和 Jefferies 等机构共同参与发行。《华尔街日报》称，这是 Robinhood 第一次正式担任 IPO 承销商。

Robinhood began allocating new shares to retail clients in 2021, but in the past, it primarily served a distribution role. After joining the underwriting syndicate, it can participate in issuance arrangements earlier and also has the opportunity to gain greater say over the shares reserved for platform clients. Oura plans to list on Nasdaq under the stock ticker "OURA," and the prospectus has not yet filled in the issue price and number of shares. Robinhood 从 2021 年开始向散户客户分配新股，但过去主要承担分销角色。进入承销团后，它能更早参与发行安排，也有机会在留给平台客户的份额上获得更大发言权。Oura 计划以「OURA」为股票代码在纳斯达克上市，招股书尚未填入发行价和发行股数。

This arrangement also allows Robinhood to further enter traditional investment banking from being a retail-focused trading platform. However, Oura's private placement project for employees and designated individuals is still managed by Morgan Stanley, and Robinhood's specific underwriting share has not yet been announced. 这次安排也让 Robinhood 从面向散户的交易平台进一步进入传统投行业务。不过，Oura 面向员工及指定人士的定向配售项目仍由摩根士丹利管理，Robinhood 的具体承销份额尚未公布。

item.title: Mistral 完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超 210 亿欧元
item.guid: Mistral-完成-30-亿欧元-D-轮融资，投后估值超-210-亿欧元
item.description:
French AI company Mistral announced on September 8 that it has completed a €3 billion Series D funding round, valuing the company at over €21 billion post-money. The company stated that this is the largest single round of equity financing completed by a European tech company to date. 法国 AI 公司 Mistral 9 月 8 日宣布完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超过 210 亿欧元。公司称，这是欧洲科技公司迄今完成的最大单轮股权融资。

This round of financing was led by Samsung Electronics, with EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund and existing investor PSG Equity co-leading; Advent, funds managed by BlackRock, and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg joined as investors, while existing shareholders such as ASML, NVIDIA, a16z, Bpifrance, and Salesforce Ventures continued to follow on. 本轮融资由三星电子领投，EQT 管理的 Scaleup Europe Fund 与现有投资者 PSG Equity 共同领投；Advent、贝莱德管理的基金和卢森堡大公国加入投资，ASML、英伟达、a16z、法国公共投资银行、Salesforce Ventures 等现有股东继续跟投。

Mistral stated that the funds will be used for cutting-edge model research, training compute power, infrastructure expansion, and commercial and international business growth. The company currently operates in 20 countries, providing AI services to over 125 enterprises, including Airbus, ASML, and HSBC. Mistral 表示，资金将用于前沿模型研究、训练算力、基础设施扩建，以及商业和国际业务增长。公司目前在 20 个国家开展业务，为空中客车、ASML、汇丰等超过 125 家企业提供 AI 服务。

item.title: 💡 梁琛奇：AI 娱乐产品要让消费过程实时使用算力
item.guid: 💡-梁琛奇：AI-娱乐产品要让消费过程实时使用算力
item.description:
Liang Chenqi, former head of ByteDance's AI product team Flow, stated in an interview with "LatePost" that if AI entertainment products only reduce content production costs, the resulting short dramas, comics, or videos will still return to existing platforms; new independent platforms need to allow users to interact with models in real-time during consumption and obtain long-tail feedback that did not exist before. 字节跳动前 AI 产品团队 Flow 负责人梁琛奇接受《晚点》采访时表示，AI 娱乐产品若只降低内容生产成本，产出的短剧、漫画或视频仍会回到既有平台；新的独立平台需要让用户在消费过程中实时与模型互动，并获得过去不存在的长尾反馈。

He summarized the conditions for the establishment of AI entertainment as cost, modality, and user habits. After DeepSeek-R1, inference costs continue to decline; image and video models have crossed the usability threshold; and users have also learned to interact with AI through products like ChatGPT and Doubao. Based on these changes, he believes that entertainment products can shift from static generation to consuming and generating images, videos, or gameplay simultaneously. 他把 AI 娱乐的成立条件归纳为成本、模态和用户习惯。DeepSeek-R1 之后，推理成本继续下降；图片和视频模型跨过可用门槛；用户也已经通过 ChatGPT、豆包等产品学会与 AI 交互。基于这些变化，他判断娱乐产品可以从静态生成转向一边消费、一边生成图片、视频或玩法。

Liang Chenqi's "Dongnian Yinxian" is simultaneously developing and testing seven or eight products, with one or two-person teams creating demos within two weeks to a month, and then deciding whether to shut down or add resources based on real user signals. Its first product, "Pinecone Moments," can expand photos and text into multi-image stories with voiceovers, background music, and simple animations; the team's next step will be to target content towards specific groups and try to allow the consumption side to also call models in real-time. 梁琛奇创办的「动念引线」正在同时开发和测试七八个产品，由一两人的小组在两周至一个月内做出 Demo，再按真实用户信号决定关停或追加资源。其首款产品「松果时刻」可把照片和文字扩展为带配音、配乐和简单动画的多图故事；团队下一步会把内容收向特定人群，并尝试让消费端也实时调用模型。

He believes that AI entertainment still cannot do without human subjective expression: models are good at generating a "sense of familiarity" based on user preferences, while true surprise and content diversity come from creators. A product needs to simultaneously satisfy novelty, longevity, high frequency, and resistance to boredom, and form sustainable signals in terms of retention and usage frequency. 他认为，AI 娱乐仍离不开人的主观表达：模型擅长根据用户偏好生成「熟悉感」，真正的惊喜和内容多样性则来自创作者。产品成立需要同时满足新颖、长期、高频和不易厌倦，并在留存与使用频次上形成可持续信号。

item.title: 荣耀 Magic9 Pro Max 绿色外观曝光，后摄采用「1+2」转塔布局
item.guid: 荣耀-Magic9-Pro-Max-绿色外观曝光，后摄采用「1+2」转塔布局
item.description:
Renderings of the Honor Magic9 Pro Max's green body leaked on social media on September 8. The image shows the body adopting a metal and back panel splicing design, with the camera module arranged in a "1+2" configuration consisting of a large circle on the left and two small circles on the right; the left area also features a periscope lens, flash, and ARRI logo. 荣耀 Magic9 Pro Max 的绿色机身渲染图 9 月 8 日在社交平台流出。图中机身采用金属与背板拼接设计，镜头模组为左侧大圆与右侧两个小圆组成的「1+2」排列；左侧区域还出现了潜望镜头、闪光灯和 ARRI 标识。

This appearance is described as referencing the three-lens turret structure of ARRI ARRIFLEX cinema cameras. Honor has confirmed that its technical cooperation with ARRI will be applied to the next-generation Magic9 series, but the color scheme, body structure, and camera configuration shown in the leaked images have not yet been officially confirmed. 这套外观被描述为参考 ARRI ARRIFLEX 电影机的三镜头转塔结构。荣耀已确认与 ARRI 的技术合作会应用于下一代 Magic9 系列，但流出图所示的配色、机身结构与摄像头配置尚未获官方确认。

The same batch of leaks also listed parameters such as a 6.8-inch LTPO OLED flat screen, 3D facial recognition, dual 200-megapixel main cameras, and a periscope telephoto lens. These specifications are still unconfirmed information; the confirmed new points from this exposure are mainly the green body and the turret-style rear camera layout. 同一批爆料还列出 6.8 英寸级 LTPO OLED 直屏、3D 人脸识别和双 2 亿像素主摄、潜望长焦等参数。这些规格仍属未证实信息，此次曝光的可确认新增点主要是绿色机身与转塔式后摄布局。

item.title: MagicOS 11 定档 9 月 15 日发布，主打系统级 Agent
item.guid: MagicOS-11-定档-9-月-15-日发布，主打系统级-Agent
item.description:
Honor announced the schedule for its 2026 Global Developer Conference, where MagicOS 11 will be released in Shenzhen on September 15 from 19:00 to 20:00. The official positioning of the new system is for the commercial implementation of system-level agents, and sub-forums on AI, gaming, and smart home will continue to introduce development capabilities. 荣耀公布 2026 全球开发者大会日程，MagicOS 11 将于 9 月 15 日 19:00 至 20:00 在深圳发布。官方把新系统定位为系统级 Agent 商用落地，并安排 AI、游戏和智慧家庭等分论坛继续介绍开发能力。

Already announced system changes include a new liquid glass visual effect, lossless compression and redundant file cleanup, multi-protocol fast charging adaptation, and weak network optimization where AI selects the network. Honor stated that the overall smoothness of all series models will be improved by more than 20%, and a 4K Live "record-while-shoot" function will be added. 已经公布的系统变化包括全新液态玻璃视觉效果、无损压缩与冗余文件清理、多协议快充适配，以及由 AI 选择网络的弱网优化。荣耀称，全系列机型的整机流畅度将提升 20% 以上，并加入 4K Live「录中拍」功能。

Honor has not yet listed compatible models and specific upgrade batches. This developer conference will last for one day, with the system release scheduled for the evening main forum. 荣耀尚未列出兼容机型和具体升级批次。这场开发者大会将持续一天，系统发布安排在晚间主论坛。

item.title: iQOO 16 与 iQOO Pad Ultra 定档 9 月底发布
item.guid: iQOO-16-与-iQOO-Pad-Ultra-定档-9-月底发布
item.description:
iQOO announced that the iQOO 16 phone and iQOO Pad Ultra tablet will be launched simultaneously at the end of September. The official teaser video showcased the names and back designs of both products, with the phone continuing to use a square camera module, while the tablet features a centered matrix-style lens area. iQOO 宣布，iQOO 16 手机与 iQOO Pad Ultra 平板将在 9 月底同场发布。官方预热视频展示了两款产品的名称和背部设计，手机继续采用方形相机模组，平板则使用居中的矩阵式镜头区域。

Existing leaks suggest that the iQOO 16 will feature a 6.8-inch flat screen, a fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition processor, and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto lens, with a battery capacity possibly exceeding 7000mAh; the iQOO Pad Ultra may be equipped with a Dimensity 9600, a 14-inch screen, and a 16000mAh battery. These parameters have not yet been officially confirmed. 现有爆料称，iQOO 16 将采用 6.8 英寸直屏、第五代骁龙 8 至尊版处理器和 2 亿像素潜望长焦，电池容量可能超过 7000mAh；iQOO Pad Ultra 则可能搭载天玑 9600、14 英寸屏幕和 16000mAh 电池。这些参数尚未得到官方确认。

Certification information indicates that the iQOO 16 is expected to support 66W wired charging. iQOO will announce the full configuration and sales arrangements at the launch event at the end of the month. 认证信息显示，iQOO 16 预计支持 66W 有线充电。iQOO 将在月底发布会上公布完整配置和销售安排。

item.title: 智象未来 vivago R1 全球上线，主打 5 分钟长视频生成
item.guid: 智象未来-vivago-R1-全球上线，主打-5-分钟长视频生成
item.description:
HiDream.ai announced yesterday that its content creation AI agent vivago R1 has officially launched globally, with its domestic version "Gouda" simultaneously upgraded. 智象未来（HiDream.ai）昨日宣布旗下内容创作 AI 智能体 vivago R1 全球正式上线，其国内版本「够搭」同步升级。

Official data shows that vivago.ai's global user base has now exceeded 70 million. Unlike the industry's mainstream 15 to 30-second short clip generation, vivago R1 focuses on long video creation, supporting stable output of 5-minute high-quality videos in one go, and has unlimited multi-round extension capabilities. 官方数据显示，目前 vivago.ai 全球用户量已突破 7000 万。与行业主流 15 至 30 秒的短片段生成不同，vivago R1 主打长视频创作，支持一次性稳定输出 5 分钟高质量视频，并具备无限次多轮延长能力。

The product adopts a 'Chat-First' mode, allowing users to drive video generation and modification through natural language conversations without adjusting complex nodes and parameters. 产品采用「对话优先」（Chat-First）模式，用户无需调节复杂的节点与参数，通过自然语言对话即可驱动视频生成与修改。

In terms of underlying architecture, the product relies on its self-developed HD-AgentOS for task decomposition and multi-agent collaboration. The official claim is that the success rate of effective and usable content has increased to 85%, effectively mitigating inconsistencies in characters and scenes across different shots. Currently, vivago R1 is open for global users to experience. 底层架构上，产品依托自研 HD-AgentOS 进行任务拆解与多 Agent 协同，官方称内容有效可用成功率提升至 85%，有效缓解了跨镜头人物和场景不一致的问题。目前 vivago R1 已面向全球用户开放体验。

🔗 Related reading: Hands-on test of the globally launched vivago R1: I used it to create a cyberpunk Journey to the West short film 🔗 相关阅读： 实测全球上线的 vivago R1，我用它打造了一部赛博西游记短片

item.title: 9999 元，索尼发布首款全画幅鱼眼变焦镜头 FE 8-14mm F3.5 G
item.guid: 9999-元，索尼发布首款全画幅鱼眼变焦镜头-FE-8-14mm-F3.5-G
item.description:
Sony (China) Co., Ltd. officially released its first full-frame fisheye zoom G lens, the FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G (model: SEL814G), yesterday. 索尼（中国）有限公司昨日正式发布旗下首款全画幅鱼眼变焦 G 镜头 FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G（型号：SEL814G）。

This lens extends the wide-angle end of Sony E-mount original lenses to 8mm, filling a product gap for Sony's full-frame fisheye lenses. The official suggested retail price is 9999 yuan, and it will be officially launched in mid-September. 该镜头将索尼 E 卡口原厂镜头的广角端拓展至 8mm，填补了索尼全画幅鱼眼镜头的产品空白，官方建议零售价为 9999 元，将于 9 月中旬正式上市。

item.title: Xiaomi MiMo Desktop 开放邀测，可直接交付 PPT 和交互网页
item.guid: Xiaomi-MiMo-Desktop-开放邀测，可直接交付-PPT-和交互网页
item.description:
Xiaomi Technology announced on September 8th that the Xiaomi MiMo Desktop client is open for invitation-based testing. Approved users can use two new models, MiMo-X-Pro-Preview and MiMo-X-Flash-Preview, for free for a limited time and quantity during the testing period. 小米技术 9 月 8 日宣布，Xiaomi MiMo Desktop 桌面客户端开放邀测。申请通过的用户可在测试期间限时、限量免费使用 MiMo-X-Pro-Preview 与 MiMo-X-Flash-Preview 两款新模型。

MiMo Desktop can receive various formats of materials, decompose targets, call tools, and finally deliver editable results such as PPTs, Office files, web pages, and lightweight games. It supports previewing page interactions within a session, can operate Figma via MCP, or directly control browsers to retrieve, fill forms, and extract materials. MiMo Desktop 可接收多种格式的素材，拆分目标并调用工具，最后交付可继续编辑的 PPT、Office 文件、网页和轻量游戏等成果。它支持在会话内预览页面交互，也能通过 MCP 操作 Figma，或直接控制浏览器检索、填写表单和提取素材。

Users can select text, charts, or page areas within the results for partial regeneration, with each modification retaining version history. The built-in 'Smart' mode dispatches tasks among different models, agents, and skill paths based on task type and complexity; large tasks can also be broken down and collaboratively processed by multiple independent sessions. 用户可选中成果里的文字、图表或页面区域局部重新生成，每次修改会保留版本记录。内置的「Smart」模式会根据任务类型和复杂度，在不同模型、Agent 与 Skill 路径之间调度；大型任务还可拆给多个独立会话协同处理。

item.title: WhatsApp 测试接入第三方 AI Agent，单个账号最多连接 5 个
item.guid: WhatsApp-测试接入第三方-AI-Agent，单个账号最多连接-5-个
item.description:
WhatsApp is developing third-party AI Agent integration in its Android beta. Users can create dedicated bot conversations within the app, WhatsApp will generate an API Key, and users can then enter the key into the corresponding Agent platform, allowing locally or cloud-run Agents to directly receive commands and return results in the chat window. WhatsApp 正在 Android 测试版中开发第三方 AI Agent 接入功能。用户可在应用内创建专用机器人会话，WhatsApp 会生成 API Key，再由用户把密钥填入对应的 Agent 平台，使本地或云端运行的 Agent 直接在聊天窗口接收指令和返回结果。

Each account can currently connect up to 5 Agents, and can set names and avatars for each. Agents can only read content actively sent by the user to that dedicated conversation, cannot access other chats, contacts, or media, and temporarily cannot join group chats or communities. 每个账号目前最多可连接 5 个 Agent，并能分别设置名称和头像。Agent 只能读取用户主动发到该专用会话中的内容，不能访问其他聊天、联系人或媒体，也暂时不能加入群聊和社区。

This feature is not yet widely available and is currently only offered to some Android users. It's important to note that third-party Agent conversations do not support end-to-end encryption at this stage; WhatsApp will also warn that AI replies may be inaccurate, and users need to verify the results themselves. 这项功能尚未广泛开放，当前只向部分 Android 用户提供。需要留意的是，第三方 Agent 会话现阶段不支持端到端加密；WhatsApp 也会提示 AI 回复可能不准确，用户需自行核对结果。

item.title: 面壁智能开源 MiniCPM5-2B，AA v4.2 评测位列 4B 以下开源模型第一
item.guid: 面壁智能开源-MiniCPM5-2B，AA-v4.2-评测位列-4B-以下开源模型第一
item.description:
ModelBest released and open-sourced MiniCPM5-2B. This is a 2.6 billion parameter dense model, with an Intelligence Index v4.2 score of 15 from Artificial Analysis, ranking first among open-source weight models with less than 4 billion parameters collected by the agency. 面壁智能发布并开源 MiniCPM5-2B。这是一款 26 亿参数的稠密模型，Artificial Analysis 的 Intelligence Index v4.2 得分为 15，在该机构收录的 40 亿参数以下开源权重模型中排名第一。

MiniCPM5-2B supports a 131,000 token context, uses the Apache 2.0 license, and can be deployed on mobile phones, tablets, and edge devices. The model card also provides pre-trained, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and quantized versions, making it convenient for developers to use under different computational power conditions. MiniCPM5-2B 支持 13.1 万 token 上下文，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，可部署在手机、平板和边缘设备上。模型卡同时提供预训练、监督微调、强化学习和量化版本，方便开发者按不同算力条件使用。

In Artificial Analysis's detailed tests, MiniCPM5-2B scored 831 in GDPval-AA, 34 in the combined Terminal-Bench Hard and τ²-Bench Telecom items of the Agentic Index, and 438 in the Briefcase Index. The 23 points cited in ModelBest's promotional materials are from the old v4.1.1 metric and cannot be directly compared with the current v4.2 score. Artificial Analysis 的细项测试中，MiniCPM5-2B 在 GDPval-AA 获得 831 分，在 Agentic Index 的 Terminal-Bench Hard 和 τ²-Bench Telecom 汇总项中获得 34 分，在 Briefcase Index 获得 438 分。面壁智能宣传材料引用的 23 分来自旧版 v4.1.1 指标，不能与当前 v4.2 得分直接比较。

item.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 上线，新增草图生成与局部批注编辑
item.guid: ChatGPT-Images-2.5-上线，新增草图生成与局部批注编辑
item.description:
OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.5 on September 8th. The official statement claims that the new model significantly improves fidelity to reference image subjects, local editing precision, and consistency across multiple modifications, with generation latency reduced by up to 50% compared to Images 2.0. OpenAI 9 月 8 日发布 ChatGPT Images 2.5。官方称，新模型重点改进了参考图主体保真度、局部编辑精度和多轮修改一致性，生成延迟最高比 Images 2.0 降低 50%。

ChatGPT simultaneously added Sketch, template, and image annotation features. Users can input '@Sketch' to directly draw compositions or outlines, then use text to specify styles and details; they can also start creating from templates like posters or product photos, or directly leave modification annotations on already generated images. The new version also supports attaching prompts when sharing images, making it convenient for others to replicate similar effects using their own images. ChatGPT 同步新增 Sketch、模板和图片批注功能。用户可输入「@Sketch」直接画出构图或轮廓，再用文字指定风格和细节；也可从海报、商品照等模板开始制作，或在已生成图片上直接留下修改批注。新版还支持在分享图片时附带 prompt，方便他人使用自己的图片复刻同类效果。

Images 2.5 has been progressively rolled out to ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users across desktop, mobile, and web platforms. For the API, GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst have been introduced: the former is for high-frequency, fast image workflows, while the latter emphasizes high precision and multi-edit control. Generated images will still carry C2PA metadata and invisible watermarks. Images 2.5 已向 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 各档用户在桌面端、移动端和网页端陆续开放。API 端则推出 GPT-Image-2.5 Flare 与 GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst：前者面向高频、快速的图片工作流，后者强调高精度和多次编辑控制。生成图仍会携带 C2PA 元数据和不可见水印。

item.title: McKinley 1.0 发布，可直接设计并导出自定义 SF Symbols
item.guid: McKinley-1.0-发布，可直接设计并导出自定义-SF-Symbols
item.description:
McKinley 1.0, for Apple developers and designers, has been officially released. It integrates vector drawing, symbol structure annotation, preview, and export into one application. Users can import graphics from SVG or start from a blank canvas to create custom SF Symbols. 面向 Apple 开发者和设计师的 McKinley 1.0 正式发布。它把矢量绘图、符号结构标注、预览和导出整合到一个应用中，用户可以从 SVG 导入图形，也可以从空白画布开始制作自定义 SF Symbols。

McKinley can reuse the same set of objects across various font weights, sizes, and color configurations, and calls Apple's renderer to preview results in real-time. After completing the design, symbols can be directly exported to Xcode, eliminating the need to return to Apple's SF Symbols app to handle templates and annotations. McKinley 能在多种字重、尺寸和颜色配置间复用同一组对象，并调用 Apple 的渲染器实时预览结果。完成设计后，符号可直接导出到 Xcode，无需再回到 Apple 的 SF Symbols 应用处理模板和注释。

The product's official website states that the launch offer will last until noon BST on September 14th. 产品官网称，首发优惠会持续到英国夏令时 9 月 14 日中午。

item.title: 豆包博物馆讲解模式新增 12 种方言
item.guid: 豆包博物馆讲解模式新增-12-种方言
item.description:
Doubao's museum explanation mode has added 12 new dialects. Users can photograph exhibits inside the museum and then select a dialect to receive audio explanations. Doubao has also added new museum-related identity entry points for this mode. 豆包的博物馆讲解模式新增 12 种方言，用户可以在展馆内拍摄展品，再选择方言获得语音讲解。豆包同时为该模式增加了新的博物馆相关身份入口。

This feature is built upon the museum explanation mode launched in June this year. The first batch of collaborations covered more than 20 museums. Doubao previously selected 5 exhibits for explanations and jointly held activities with 7 cultural institutions; the Shanghai Pudong Art Museum had already integrated 2 exhibits at that time. 这项功能建立在今年 6 月上线的博物馆讲解模式之上。首批合作覆盖 20 多家博物馆，豆包曾选取 5 件展品制作讲解，并与 7 家文化机构联合开展活动；上海浦东美术馆当时已有 2 件展品接入。

With the addition of new dialects, the explanation mode has expanded from identifying exhibits and generating background introductions to regionalized voice presentation. The specific list of supported dialects and covered museums is still subject to the Doubao client. 新增方言后，讲解模式从识别展品和生成背景介绍，进一步扩展到地区化语音呈现。具体支持的方言名单和覆盖展馆仍以豆包客户端为准。

item.title: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》定档 11 月 5 日，登陆 Switch 2
item.guid: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛-重制版》定档-11-月-5-日，登陆-Switch-2
item.description:
Nintendo announced at The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct held on September 8 that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remastered will launch on Switch 2 on November 5, offering both digital and physical versions, and is now available for pre-order. The initial physical edition features special textured foil packaging and is available in limited quantities. 任天堂在 9 月 8 日举行的《塞尔达传说》40 周年直面会上宣布，《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》将于 11 月 5 日登陆 Switch 2，提供数字版和实体版，并已开放预购。首发实体版采用特殊纹理烫箔包装，数量有限。

Series producer Eiji Aonuma demonstrated content such as towns, open-world exploration, combat, and music performance during the Direct. The remastered version retains the original's time travel and dungeon structure, while remaking the graphics, controls, and some convenience features. 系列制作人青沼英二在直面会上演示了城镇、野外探索、战斗和音乐演奏等内容。重制版保留原作的时间旅行与地下城结构，并重新制作画面、操控和部分便利性功能。

Before the Direct, Nintendo Australia's eShop search results briefly showed a price of AU$94.95; Nintendo has now confirmed the release date and version arrangements, but prices in other regions are still subject to local stores. The original game launched on Nintendo 64 in 1998, and this is one of the key titles Nintendo has prepared for the series' 40th anniversary. 直面会前，任天堂澳洲 eShop 搜索结果曾短暂显示 AU$94.95 的售价；任天堂现已确认发售日和版本安排，但其他地区价格仍以当地商店为准。原作于 1998 年登陆 Nintendo 64，这是任天堂为系列 40 周年准备的重点作品之一。

item.title: 喜茶恢复合伙人申请入口，客服称尚未正式重启加盟
item.guid: 喜茶恢复合伙人申请入口，客服称尚未正式重启加盟
item.description:
Heytea GO mini-program recently relaunched the "I want to be a partner" entry point, marking the first time the official application channel has reappeared since the brand suspended new franchise applications in February 2025. The entry point simultaneously updated the application guidelines, adding risk warnings such as rational assessment, prudent investment, and truthful submission of information. 喜茶 GO 小程序近日重新上线「我要成为合伙人」入口，这是品牌自 2025 年 2 月暂停新加盟申请后，官方申请渠道首次恢复显示。入口同步更新了申请须知，增加理性评估、审慎投资和如实填报资料等风险提示。

Heytea customer service stated that partnership matters have not yet been officially reopened. Applicants can fill in their information first, and the brand will contact them when the project reopens; submitting an application does not mean a partnership has been established, and Heytea may reject applications that do not meet the standards during the review process. 喜茶客服表示，目前尚未正式重新开放合伙事宜，申请人可以先填写信息，待项目再次开放后由品牌联系；提交申请也不代表已经建立合作关系，喜茶可在审核环节驳回不符合标准的申请。

Heytea first launched its business partner model in November 2022, and in early 2025, it suspended new applications citing "rejection of meaningless internal competition in scale" and began phasing out inefficient stores. This change currently only confirms the restoration of the application entry point, and new franchise policies and opening times have not yet been announced. 喜茶于 2022 年 11 月首次开放事业合伙人模式，2025 年初以「拒绝无意义规模内卷」为由暂停新增申请，并开始清退低效门店。此次变化目前只确认了申请入口恢复，尚未公布新的加盟政策和开放时间。

item.title: 霸王茶姬在上海 7 家门店试卖茶叶蛋，单点 5 元
item.guid: 霸王茶姬在上海-7-家门店试卖茶叶蛋，单点-5-元
item.description:
CHAGEE is test-selling tea eggs at 7 stores in Shanghai from September 7 to 21, priced at 5 yuan for a single order, or 2.5 yuan when purchased with a drink. The product is for dine-in only, and a 20% discount is available when combined with a drink as a set before 10:30 AM. 霸王茶姬 9 月 7 日至 21 日在上海 7 家门店试卖茶叶蛋，单点售价 5 元，随饮品加购价为 2.5 元。产品只限堂食，上午 10:30 前与饮品组成套餐还可享受八折优惠。

This test is currently only being conducted in Shanghai, with stores including those in shopping districts like MixC and Raffles City. CHAGEE has not announced whether it will expand to other cities, nor has it specified long-term arrangements after the trial sale ends. 这次测试目前只在上海进行，门店包括万象城、来福士等商圈门店。霸王茶姬没有公布是否会扩展到其他城市，也没有说明试卖结束后的长期安排。

The brand had previously added food items to some stores for breakfast, afternoon, and evening hours. Tea eggs further bring common items from traditional convenience stores and breakfast shops into tea beverage stores, aiming to increase in-store consumption during off-peak hours. 品牌此前已在部分门店按早餐、午后和晚间时段增加食品。茶叶蛋进一步把传统便利店和早餐店常见单品带进茶饮门店，目标是增加非高峰时段的到店消费。

item.title: 4 小时纪录片《马斯克》发布预告，10 月 16 日北美上映
item.guid: 4-小时纪录片《马斯克》发布预告，10-月-16-日北美上映
item.description:
The first trailer for Alex Gibney's documentary "Musk" has been released and premiered at the Venice Film Festival. The film, nearly 4 hours long, focuses on Elon Musk's business expansion, public influence, and personal conduct, with the trailer including both praise from supporters and sharp criticism from detractors. Alex Gibney 执导的纪录片《Musk》发布首支预告，并于威尼斯电影节首映。影片时长接近 4 小时，以 Elon Musk 的商业扩张、公众影响力和个人行事方式为主线，预告同时收录支持者的赞誉与批评者的尖锐评价。

Gibney previously won an Oscar for Best Documentary Feature for "Taxi to the Dark Side" and also directed "Enron: The Smartest Guys in the Room," "Going Clear: Scientology and the Prison of Belief," and the Steve Jobs documentary "Steve Jobs: The Man in the Machine." He stated that the new film will not simply judge Musk as "good or bad," but rather examine how his power operates. Gibney 曾凭《驶向阴霾的出租》获得奥斯卡最佳纪录长片奖，也执导过《安然：房间里最聪明的人》《拨开迷雾：山达基教与信仰囚笼》和 Steve Jobs 纪录片《史蒂夫·乔布斯：机器人生》。他表示，新片不会简单裁定 Musk「好或坏」，而是考察其权力如何运作。

"Musk" will be released in North American theaters by Bleecker Street on October 16, then arrive on HBO and HBO Max; after Venice, it will also be screened at the Toronto International Film Festival. 《Musk》将在 10 月 16 日由 Bleecker Street 于北美院线上映，之后登陆 HBO 和 HBO Max；威尼斯之后还会在多伦多电影节展映。

item.title: 《世界之巅》上线，回望世贸中心顶层餐厅的 25 年
item.guid: 《世界之巅》上线，回望世贸中心顶层餐厅的-25-年
item.description:
The 40-minute documentary short "Top of the World" premiered on CNN on September 8. Adapted from Tom Roston's non-fiction work and directed by Betsy West and Julie Cohen, the directors of "RBG" and "Julia," the film looks back at the 25-year history of Windows on the World, the restaurant on the 106th and 107th floors of the North Tower of the World Trade Center. 40 分钟纪录短片《世界之巅》（Top of the World）于 9 月 8 日上线 CNN。影片改编自 Tom Roston 的非虚构作品，由《女大法官金斯伯格》和《茱莉亚》的导演 Betsy West、Julie Cohen 执导，回顾世贸中心北塔 106、107 层餐厅 Windows on the World 的 25 年历史。

The film begins with the restaurant's opening in the 1970s, documenting its ups and downs during stock market cycles, its recovery after the 1993 World Trade Center bombing, and the originally planned 25th-anniversary celebration in 2001. The restaurant then had over 400 employees from more than 20 countries, speaking about 60 languages; several chefs, waiters, and managers recount their experiences in the film. 影片从 1970 年代餐厅开业讲起，记录其在股市周期中的起落、1993 年世贸中心爆炸案后的恢复，以及 2001 年原定举行的 25 周年庆典。餐厅当时有 400 多名员工，来自 20 多个国家，使用约 60 种语言；片中多位厨师、侍者和管理者讲述各自经历。

In the 9/11 terrorist attacks, 79 employees and 91 customers of Windows on the World perished. The film was previously released in a limited run in New York from August 28 to September 3 and can now be watched via the CNN website and app. 在 9·11 恐怖袭击中，Windows on the World 的 79 名员工和 91 名顾客遇难。影片此前于 8 月 28 日至 9 月 3 日在纽约限量上映，目前可通过 CNN 网站和应用观看。
